seo.title: Pricing — Meecrogate plans
seo.description: Meecrogate pricing: transparent plans to get started quickly and scale up, with no cloud lock-in.

hero.title: Pricing — From prototype to production
hero.subtitle: Straightforward plans. Prices excluding VAT, per month — integration included depending on the plan.
hero.subtitleEnd: for a demo or an Enterprise quote.

pro.name: Pro
pro.tagline: For mid-sized companies going into production
included: 5 days of integration and onboarding included

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.tagline: Built for large organisations: high security, compliance and heavy volumes.
included: Audit and a 4 to 6 week pilot to confirm Meecrogate fits your context
enterprise.optionsTitle: Build your solution à la carte from the Meecrogate modules

notes.label: Notes:
notes.text: Prices are quoted in <0>EUR excluding VAT, per month</0>. VAT is charged on top. Billing is annual, on a 1, 3 or 5 year commitment.

items.question: What does the integration cover?
items.answer: Initial setup, connection to your backends, testing and team training (duration depends on the plan: ½ day → 2 days → bespoke project).

items.question: Can we move from one plan to another without downtime?
items.answer: Yes — scaling up is smooth, and migration and integration hooks are planned with our team so nothing is interrupted.

items.question: Is there a proof-of-concept offer?
items.answer: Yes: a POC pack is available, and the fee is refunded when you sign a Pro or Enterprise contract. Contact sales for the terms.

contactStrip.description: Dedicated team, migration, GDPR compliance or on-premise deployment: let's talk.
